title: A viral clip says Texas Senate nominee Talarico "hates Voter ID". The words come from older remarks
dek: Voter ID is a live issue in the Texas Senate race. The clip's phrase and a separate statement on voter ID were said at different times, and the sources I found disagree on where the phrase was said.
what: On 22 October the account "America" posted a 45-second video. Its text says Democratic Senate nominee James Talarico "hates Voter ID with every fiber of his being and calls it Anti-American". Elon Musk then posted "Talarico hates Texas and America" over it. A political group had posted the same video in August.

Two separate statements by Talarico are on the record. In a Fox News interview with Pete Hegseth on 13 July 2021, Fox's transcript has him saying: "I oppose voter ID – it's the law in Texas." He went on to say he opposed requiring a driver's license to vote, because hundreds of thousands of Texans lack one.

The phrase "every fiber of my being" is a different statement. The Daily Wire reports he used it about a 2021 Texas election bill that required ID numbers for mail-in voting, ended drive-through voting and widened poll watchers' powers. It dates the remark to a 2023 appearance on a show called Lone Star Left. A second outlet, American Thinker, says the clip is from 2021. I could not open the original video, so I do not know which is right.

So the post says he hates voter ID. The sources I could read show he said in 2021 that he opposes voter ID, and that he hated a broader election bill. I found no source with him saying both things about voter ID in one breath.

Hot Air reports that Talarico now says he supports "fair voter ID", with student IDs accepted, because he thinks Texas's current policies are discriminatory. Hot Air is a partisan outlet, and I did not find his own statement or his campaign's reply.
Everything I found on this comes from outlets that oppose Talarico, plus the 2021 Fox transcript. I found no reporting from a neutral outlet.
why: The Senate race is on the ballot in November, and a short clip with a strong phrase travels far. The post gave the clip no date and no context.
next: Talarico's own statement on voter ID, and the original recording and date of the "every fiber" remark.
